newsitem.title: CHINA: Airbus China centre attracts 13 firms.
newsitem.headline: Airbus China centre attracts 13 firms.

text.p: Thirteen aerospace companies are to open offices in a training and service centre being built in China by France's Airbus Industrie, the official Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Airbus was investing $50 million in opening the centre with Chinese partner China Aviation Supplies Corp, Xinhua said.
By setting up offices in the centre, to open in 1997, the companies could offer technical help and spare parts to Chinese buyers, Xinhua added.
Among the firms planning to set up operations were Airbus unit Aerospatiale and Allied-Signal Inc of the United States, the agency said.
Many of the firms were expected to open repair facilities to cut down on servicing costs and times, it said. Xinhua gave no further details.
